# 🚀 Full-Stack Web App Learning Roadmap
## React (Frontend) + Go (Backend) | 7天学习计划

---

## 📅 Day 1: Development Environment Setup & Go Basics

### Morning - Theory (3 hours)

**Content:**
- Development environment setup / 开发环境配置
  - VS Code + Extensions
  - Node.js & npm
  - Go installation & workspace
- Go language fundamentals / Go语言基础
  - Package management
  - Variables & Data Types
  - Control Flow

**Key Terms / 关键词:**
| English | 中文 |
|---------|------|
| Package | 包 |
| Variable | 变量 |
| Data Type | 数据类型 |
| Function | 函数 |
| Control Flow | 控制流 |

### Afternoon - Exercises (3 hours)

**Exercise 1: Go Environment Check**
```bash
# Install Go and verify
go version
go mod init myproject

# Create a simple hello world
mkdir day1 && cd day1
```

**Exercise 2: Basic Go Programs**
```go
// hello.go
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
    // Variables
    name := "World"
    age := 25
    
    fmt.Printf("Hello, %s!\n", name)
    fmt.Printf("Age: %d\n", age)
    
    // Simple function
    result := add(10, 20)
    fmt.Printf("10 + 20 = %d\n", result)
}

func add(a, b int) int {
    return a + b
}
```

**Exercise 3: Run and test**
```bash
go run hello.go
```
